title: Sparse polynomial thresholds as threshold compositions
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$. If $f$ is represented as the sign threshold of a real polynomial whose Fourier support has size at most $s$, then $f$ is a threshold of at most $2ns$ linear threshold functions.
